units.source_text: 若无其事地继续对弈的名人，倒令我仿佛听到了愤怒的话语，心中更添了几分感动。

en.t: The Master, continuing the game as if nothing had happened, instead made me feel as though I could hear words of anger, and I was all the more moved.

units.source_text: 从六月到十二月，今天名人还坚持下这盘告别棋，令人感慨万千。

en.t: From June to December, the Master had persevered with this farewell game even today, a fact that filled one with countless emotions.
